optimization_config.rationale: hmin/hmax chosen based on annulus width (0.4 m); diffusion=1e-4 standard for level-set regularization; v0=1e-3; 30 iterations; level set initialized as signed distance to inner circle (all solid); boundary_labels contains design (movable) boundary Gamma_i (label 2); fixed_labels contains fixed boundary Gamma_o (label 3).
